content.text:
# std/cargo's image (design/caos-expr.md, Phase 3). cargo is a flake
# (flake.nix + flake.lock + bake.nix), so its image is the flake-builder applied
# to this directory. It names the builder by a LOCAL deep-deps mount
# (DEEP-DEPS/flake-builder, declared in DEPS) — the only way it CAN name it,
# since nothing resolves a builtin by name.
#
# This is a `run` of a seeded worker, so its key can't be a pure assembly:
# resolving DEEP-DEPS/flake-builder evaluates flake-builder's own `.caos-expr`
# to its (seeded) image. bootstrap hand-builds the cargo image delta and seeds
# it under the arg-tree key this expression forms — `{ image: <flake-builder
# delta>, in: <this deepened tree> }` — so resolving this entry returns that
# delta without the flake-builder worker ever running (design/caos-expr.md, the
# hand-assembled seed keys).
run --base:@=DEEP-DEPS/flake-builder --in:@=.
